verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's products page explicitly targets employer-side, multi-hire use: it says you can "run multiple cases in parallel with clean workflows, SLAs, and status dashboards" and that it plugs into People Ops across candidate, manager and attorney. It also cites offer-to-start-date timelines and flat pricing to "forecast spend across teams", and the homepage lists startup clients (Replit, Midjourney, YC collaboration) as scale-up proof. Missing for 10: substantive documentation of the dashboard and multi-case tooling beyond marketing one-liners, a named startup/scale-up program with stated terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration that team-scale case management works as claimed.
